items.title: Another Perth beach closed as more whale remains found

children.content: All beaches in Sorrento, where a man was attacked and killed by a great white shark last month, have been closed after a whale's tail was found offshore.

items.title: One in three homicides linked to psychosis as psychiatrists fear crisis

children.content: Frustrated psychiatrists and lawyers say an alarming uptick in homicides by people with psychosis is a triple tragedy for perpetrators, victims and the wider public because many of the deaths could have been prevented.

items.title: Archaeologists find treasure trove of ancient artefacts in Juukan Gorge
